description: This file defines the ImageMap class, a specialized map component built on Leaflet, for rendering image overlays with dynamic positioning, resizing, and data-driven image sources within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ImageMap
classes.description: A Leaflet-based map class for displaying image overlays with dynamic data integration, resizing, and coordinate conversions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ImageMap instance, sets up data subscriptions, and prepares the map with image overlay.

methods.name: mapImage
methods.description: Retrieves the map image either from a URL or via entity attribute subscription.

methods.name: imageFromUrl
methods.description: Loads an image from a URL and retrieves its aspect ratio.

methods.name: imageFromAlias
methods.description: Processes data from an alias subscription to load the corresponding image.

methods.name: updateBounds
methods.description: Updates the map bounds and overlays based on current image size and position.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the map and image overlay when container size changes.

methods.name: initMap
methods.description: Initializes the Leaflet map with specified options and CRS.

methods.name: extractPosition
methods.description: Extracts x and y position data from formatted data.

methods.name: positionToLatLng
methods.description: Converts a position object to a Leaflet LatLng object.

methods.name: convertPosition
methods.description: Converts data position to map LatLng using a position function.

methods.name: convertPositionPolygon
methods.description: Converts polygon coordinate expressions to map LatLng points.

methods.name: pointToLatLng
methods.description: Converts x,y coordinates to Leaflet LatLng using CRS.

methods.name: latLngToPoint
methods.description: Converts LatLng to x,y point coordinates.

methods.name: convertToCustomFormat
methods.description: Converts a LatLng position to custom coordinate format for data storage.

methods.name: convertToPolygonFormat
methods.description: Converts polygon points to custom coordinate format.

methods.name: convertPolygonToCustomFormat
methods.description: Converts polygon expression to custom format.

methods.name: convertCircleToCustomFormat
methods.description: Converts circle data to custom format.

methods.name: convertToCircleFormat
methods.description: Converts circle data from custom format to map coordinates.
